title: Payments restarts with exit code 137
query: Payments keeps restarting with exit code 137 after its memory climbed for hours.
root_cause: Payments is being killed for running out of memory after a gradual memory leak.

remediation.detail: Restart payments, fix the memory leak and add a memory trend alert.

evidence: The payments container exit code is 137 and it restarts repeatedly
Memory for payments climbed for hours before the restarts
